items.title: Welcome
items.desc: Opening remarks from the Chairs and a remembrance of Ryan Séguin.

items.title: Keynote
items.desc: Speaker announced soon. An opening talk on the future of POCUS education.

items.title: Case competition
items.desc: Updates from last year’s grant winners, then teams present live in breakout rooms.

items.title: Workshops A and B (choose one)
items.desc: Workshop A: mentorship speed round, small-group Q&As with POCUS leaders from across Canada. Workshop B: high-yield scans for medical students, led by a resident. Both run at the same time in breakout rooms.

items.title: Closing and case competition winners
items.desc: The three winning teams are announced and present their pitch to everyone, then closing remarks from the Chairs.
